spec2def(devcpux.dll devcpux.spec)

# devcpux.dll is all Rust (devcpux-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/devcpux-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# processor.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/devcpux-rust/src/devcpux/processor.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(devcpux_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(devcpux_shims PRIVATE libuser32 libpowrprof libcomctl32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(devcpux_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(devcpux devcpux-cargo devcpux.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE devcpux-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS devcpux_shims psdk)
